newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN IPO - Garden Cements Ltd.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN IPO - Garden Cements Ltd.

text.p: Research supplied by Sebastian Dominic of Resource Base, a New Delhi-based private investment consultancy firm. Tel: 578 0840. This data is for investor information only and does not constitute a recommendation by Reuters.
Garden Cements is coming out with the public issue to finance setting up a 66,000 tonne cement plant, to meet the working capital requirements and expanses of the present issue.

The project cost of 77 million rupees is to be financed through 65.54 million rupees equity capital, 10 million rupees term loan and a subsidy of 1.50 million rupees. The project cost of 77 million rupees includes 13.70 million rupees for land and building, 34.57 million rupees for plant and machinery, 11 million rupees for miscellaneous fixed assets, 4.30 million rupees for working capital and 10 million rupees for miscellaneous expenses and contingencies.

The project to be located at Khasara in Rajasthan will manufacture 66,000 tonnes per annum (TPA) of ordinary portland cement employing VSK technology. Plant and machinery will be purchased from Mini-Tech, Delhi who have made identical supplies to similar projects in the past.
